feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Blog
feeds.description: Get Pastoral Insights from a Reformed Baptist Perspective. The Reformed Baptist Blog seeks to maintain a pastoral focus, with a balance of teaching the Church. Reformed Baptist focuses on the Biblical basis for and the distinctiveness of Reformed Baptist Federalism. The blog also seeks to inform, especially within the Reformed Baptist community about matters of interest to them.

feeds.title: Covenant Baptist Theological Seminary Blog
feeds.description: Explore our latest posts, podcasts, event updates, and more. Covenant Baptist Theological Seminary is a Confessional Reformed Baptist Seminary Providing Affordable Online Theological Education to Help the Church in its Calling to Train Faithful Men for the Gospel Ministry. Our vision is to see the church of the Lord Jesus Christ strengthened and expanded worldwide.

feeds.title: Providence Reformed Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Read what defines our church as a historically Reformed Baptist church. At Providence Reformed Baptist Church we are Reformed Baptists. We desire to be biblical in our orthodoxy and orthopraxy. The Bible is our ultimate authority for all wisdom and guidance. We believe that the Kingdom of God is not only a future hope but is also a present reality.

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to foster conversation for regular people about their all-powerful God. John Gill, The primary person behind this blog, serves as pastor at Grace Baptist Church. His hope and prayer are that God will cause him to be of some use to his church by helping Christians to think deeply about their faith and what it means to live out of that depth.

feeds.title: Stylos
feeds.description: Stylos is the blog of Jeff Riddle, a Reformed Baptist Pastor. Pastor Jeff has over 20 years of practical ministry experience and has previously served as a missionary in Budapest, Hungary, and as Pastor of two Baptist churches in Virginia. Jeff urges his readers to consider 'how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar (stylos) and ground of the truth.'

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Sermons from Namibia Blog.
feeds.description: Welcome to this Sermon Blog. These sermons have been preached by Pastor Joachim Rieck of the Eastside Baptist Church, Namibia. They are published as an additional help or resource for our congregation and anybody who may profit from them. Joachim Rieck is looking forward to the glory that is to come.

feeds.title: Emmausrbc Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Baptism, Catechism, Liberalism, Pastoral Ministry, and more. Emmaus is a Reformed Baptist church. We are a community of Christ followers who love God, love one another, and serve the church, community, and nations, for the glory of God and our joy. We are committed to the fulfillment of the Great Commission given by our Lord. We hope that you will begin to grow with us.

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Christian Blogger
feeds.description: A blog for Reformed writings based on Scripture alone, faith alone, by grace alone, in Christ alone, and glory to God alone.

feeds.title: Broken Wharfe
feeds.description: Broken Wharfe exists to glorify Christ and edify his church through the production, republication, and dissemination of confessional Baptist resources. Broken Wharfe is dedicated to exploring the depth of God's Word as summarised in the Second London Baptist Confession of Faith.

feeds.title: Redeemer Reformed Baptist Church
feeds.description: Enjoy our weekly devotionals written by our pastors. Redeemer Reformed Baptist Church is a Christ-centered and Bible-saturated, reformed Baptist church. Everything that we do points to Jesus and is filled with the truth of the Bible. We are passionately focused on giving worship services. focused on the Word and worship.

feeds.title: A Reformed Baptist in Namibia
feeds.description: Get news, views, and opinions from a Namibian Perspective. This blog exists to create an awareness of the spiritual scene in Namibia from the perspective of one who has a 'Reformed and Baptist bend' in his theological framework. Here you will find several historical, theological, and contemporary reflections upon life in Namibia, along with reports on various important conferences within our sphere of influence.

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Blog » Sermons and Preaching
feeds.description: Read posts about Sermons and Preaching written by Keith Throop. The Reformed Baptist Blog seeks to maintain a pastoral focus, with a balance of teaching the Church as well as warning the Church to beware of potential and actual errors. The blog also seeks to inform, especially within the Reformed Baptist community about matters of interest to them.

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Seminary News
feeds.description: Reformed Baptist Seminary exists to help churches train men who aspire to the gospel ministry, as well as to provide further training for men who are already engaged in gospel ministry. The seminary's faculty instructors not only have biblical knowledge and teaching ability but also are qualified pastors engaged in pastoral ministry. We are committed to presenting a biblical theology and vision of ministry.
